description:
Outcome: First version is demonstrably usable and recoverable, from brief.md requirements and Constraints plus owner decisions
Scope: Complete role journeys; phone/accessibility checks; staging email/job validation; backup/restore drill; migrations/restarts; privacy/security checks; operator guide and deployment/rollback procedure. Excludes: Invented performance SLA or compliance claims
Acceptance: Every mapped requirement has evidence; backup restored; no cross-household/contact leak; setup/digest failure recovery documented; scheduled job configured; synthetic data sufficient for tests
Behaviour: Actionable operational errors; restore never silently overwrites production
Verification: Recorded tests, keyboard/zoom/phone walkthrough, staging mail/deployment and restore evidence. Prerequisites: T-008, T-009, T-012, T-013. Assumptions: Owner supplies production credentials/domain before launch; retention policy made owner-visible/configurable before launch
title: Release verification and recovery
